description: Changes: changes one stay's guest name, phone, e-mail, company or guest counts, as the stay window does; a guest-count change re-prices the nights not yet posted by the hotel's extra-guest charge. Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Changes the guest name, phone, e-mail, company, adults or children of one stay. A booking site's stay (Expedia, Booking.com): its name, phone, e-mail and company only; its guest count is changed on that site. First call without confirm: a preview (each detail before and after, and the new total when the guest count moves the price), nothing changes; then call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. Pets, vehicle, notes, VIP or do-not-rent marks, the room and the rate plan are not changed here. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to go ahead with the change shown in the preview
